method: 400 fixed-loadout battles using the current Combat engine; 4 opponents × 100 independent seeds, 50 on each side per opponent. Same 70-gold equipment budget, including two traveler bags; all placements validated. Post-fusion items are counted at their ingredient prices. Layouts selected only by active stars, never battle outcomes. This is a matchup benchmark, not campaign win rate or proof of the globally optimal build. Healing totals are observations, not an ablation of the item effect.
